spec: Doc 06 NFR-06/T-09 — consumer contract (S13 step 5): the ticket-family and message events Doc 13's durable consumers read.
note: The keys this document's consumers DEPEND ON, per ticket.* event. Doc13/PreChat snapshots form answers that rode the first message into form_data on ticket.created (BR-06); its message.received slice lives in fixtures/webchat/consumers/doc13-events.json. A producer removing or renaming any `reads` key breaks this document; a schema_version bump here must be reconciled deliberately. Doc13/QueuePositionPush recomputes the queue's waiting webchat positions on ticket.assigned (P-QPOS, S13 step 5b); its routing-family slices live in fixtures/routing/consumers/doc13-events.json.
